pieces.Text: At 10th level, when a vindicator confirms a critical hit, he may sacrifice a prepared 3rdlevel spell or available 3rd-level spell slot to invoke bestow curse upon the target as an immediate action (using the vindicator's caster level). The save DC increases by +2 if his weapon has a x3 critical multiplier, or by +4 if it is x4. The vindicator can also use this ability in response to being critically hit, even if the attack incapacitates or kills the vindicator.
